text: Gardening is a rewarding hobby that requires patience and dedication. One of the first steps is to prune your plants, carefully cutting away dead or overgrown branches to promote new growth and maintain their shape. Pruning also helps to direct the plant's energy towards more productive areas, leading to healthier and more vibrant blooms. Once your plants are pruned, they require regular watering to keep their roots moist and prevent them from drying out. Watering should be done in the morning or evening to reduce evaporation and ensure the water reaches the roots effectively. By following these simple steps, you can ensure your plants thrive and flourish in your garden.
